bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/glyphs.rs (glyph, NAMES), springboard/render/src/symbols.rs (symbol font lookup), springboard/sdk/src/view/animation.rs (implicit animation), springboard/ui/src/anim.rs
summary: The Symbols framework is Apple's set of universal symbol effects (appear, bounce, pulse, variableColor, replace and others) for SF Symbols images in AppKit, UIKit and SwiftUI. BifrOSt has a fixed set of 78 hand-drawn line glyphs named after SF Symbols and a generic implicit animation system, but no symbol-effect API and no symbol layers or rendering modes, so none of the effects can be applied to a symbol image.

features.apple: Symbols collection; NSImage(systemSymbolName:) is the entry point in the official overview
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/glyphs.rs (glyph, NAMES: 60 names); springboard/render/src/symbols.rs (Symbol enum, font lookup by glyph name then Unicode)
features.note: 60 named line drawings, tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10-w7.rs; unknown names draw nothing. Not the SF Symbols catalogue. The 22-symbol set maps names and code points (springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10-w7.rs). The renderer's symbol font path finds no real symbol font on the device, so the drawings are what ships

features.feature: Symbol drawing: shape painters and named icons
features.apple: No direct counterpart; the fill behind a symbol image (CGContext fill of a path into a rect)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/glyph_draw.rs (paint, disc, ring, segment, arc, ellipse, either, globe, mic, dismiss_keyboard, alarm_clock, stopwatch, timer re-exported from springboard/render/src/sdf_glyphs.rs; springboard/src/shell/glyphs.rs re-exports the same); springboard/sdk/src/symbol_draw.rs (SymbolStyle, paint_layer)
features.note: The shell's painters are the SDK's, and bifrost_app::symbol_draw applies a symbol's weight stroke factor, scale, rendering mode (hierarchical opacity by layer, palette slots, monochrome) and palette to each layer (headless tests in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-34.rs). Gap: the named icons (globe, mic and the others) still take one colour per call with no layered form, and a Midget check is still needed for parity.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (symbols, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no SDK type or call applies a symbol effect to a glyph; glyphs are drawn once per frame with no per-layer state

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/symbol_effect.rs (SymbolEffect, Effect::Bounce, Effect::Pulse, replace_poses); wired: springboard/src/shell/control_center.rs (start_toggle_bounce, glyph_scale; desktop panel Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Focus)
features.note: The bounce and pulse poses, the repeat and speed options and the replace hand-over are tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-12.rs; the control centre bounces its toggles, pulse is drawn nowhere yet, and the dock bounce and scroll spring are fixed motions that apps cannot request.

Cumulative and iterative fills, dimmed or hidden inactive layers and reversing cycles are a pure model, tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-13.rs as well as in the module's unit tests. Not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. No variable layers in glyphs.rs; each glyph is one colour

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (symbols, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. an app swapping one glyph for another gets a plain redraw, not a per-layer replace animation; implicit animation cannot tell a glyph change apart from any other opacity change

features.feature: Discrete and indefinite effect protocols and options
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (symbols, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no effect trait, no repeat or speed options, and no way to start or stop a looping effect on a glyph

features.feature: Breathe, rotate, wiggle, draw-on and draw-off effects
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (symbols, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. glyphs.rs draws each line in one pass; there is no stroke-progress state, so draw-on and draw-off cannot be done without a new renderer path

features.feature: Symbol weights, scales and rendering modes
features.apple: Symbol images with weight, scale and rendering modes (per the Symbols doc overview, the effects target symbol layers)
features.note: Nine weight steps, three scale steps and the hierarchical and palette rules are a pure model, tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-13.rs. Not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. The glyph renderer still draws one weight and no hierarchical or palette rendering, as docs/bifrost-ui.md records under Symbols

features.apple: Not part of the Symbols framework; the effects are the symbol-specific layer
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/animation.rs (Window::animate interpolates frame, opacity, background); springboard/ui/src/anim.rs (Animation, Curve)
features.note: the animation system exists and retargets mid-flight (a_retargeted_spring_keeps_its_speed, headless_swatch_settles_on_the_new_frame_when_the_animation_ends in springboard/sdk/src/view/animation.rs), but it animates whole views and cannot reach individual symbol layers, so it is a base for symbol effects rather than one

gaps: Symbol effects exist as a pure model with a combined per-instant frame (springboard/ui/src/symbol_effect.rs: frame, EffectFrame, bounce up and down, variable colour, automatic) but their durations and amounts are not yet measured: the reference binary is inside a dyld cache that is not unpacked. Drawing integration in glyphs.rs for the new frame is still to do
No content transition for swapping one symbol for another; a glyph change is a plain redraw
No draw-on and draw-off effects; glyphs have no stroke-progress or per-layer state, so variable colour layers are not drawn
The glyph set is 78 hand-drawn names (springboard/sdk/src/glyphs.rs NAMES), one weight, no variable or palette rendering, not the SF Symbols catalogue
The SF Symbols font path in springboard/render/src/symbols.rs has no symbol font on the device to resolve against
